stories.title: CBP reminding holiday travelers to be prepared at US border crossings this holiday season
stories.summary: U.S. Customs and Border Protection urges travelers entering the U.S. via land borders to prepare by checking documents, declaring goods, and using travel resources.

stories.title: Local nonprofit to open model train display at McKinley Mall this Black Friday
stories.summary: Looking for something different to do this holiday season? The FCTT HiRailers are opening a free, permanent model train display at McKinley Mall on Black Friday!

stories.title: Buffalo man sentenced to 20 years for shooting man in 2025, leading to the man's death
stories.summary: A Buffalo man has been sentenced to 20 years in prison for shooting a man on Roslyn Street in 2025. The man later died from his injuries.

stories.title: Goo Goo Dolls frontman Rzeznik visits special penguin named after band’s beloved hit
stories.summary: A special stop for the Goo Goo Dolls ruffled some feathers. Singer John Rzeznik had a memorable meet-and-greet at the Aquarium of Niagara ahead of Thanksgiving Day.

stories.title: Cheektowaga firm produces power transformers amidst supply shortages with power grid updates and expansion
stories.summary: As New York faces increased energy demands, the century-old Niagara Power Transformer company in Cheektowaga expands with state support to meet demand.

stories.title: New York court rules social media firms not liable in Buffalo Tops mass shooting lawsuit
stories.summary: New York's highest court ruled social media platforms aren't liable for radicalizing Payton Gendron, who killed 10 Black people.

stories.title: Todaro calls for executive session of Erie Co. Legislature to discuss Seneca-Babcock's $4.8M in unaccounted for funds
stories.summary: The Comptrollers report on Seneca-Babcock Community Associations finances revealed $4.8M is unaccounted for and now Leg. Todaro wants an executive session about it.

stories.title: The return of Tom and Jerry season
stories.summary: Glen Park Tavern in Williamsville is preparing to serve upwards of 8,000 of the festive Tom and Jerry cocktail this holiday season.

stories.title: Russ Salvatore to be honored before Bills Chiefs game on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Restaurateur and philanthropist Russell Salvatore has been a long time supporter of the Buffalo Bills and its fans, and now will be given a special honor Thursday.

stories.title: Family of Md Rawnaq Hassan Ratin questions how to bridge cultural divide after Richard Walls acquittal
stories.summary: After Richard Walls' acquittal in the shooting of Md Rawnaq Ratin, Buffalo's racial tensions flaring between two groups in Buffalo, with advocates calling for peace.

stories.title: Code Blue issued for Monday night
stories.summary: A Code Blue alert has been issued for Monday in Buffalo and Erie County. The overnight shelter can be found at 528 South Park Avenue in Buffalo.

stories.title: Amherst Police locate missing vulnerable person
stories.summary: Amherst Police have located a missing vulnerable adult who was reported missing Monday.
